body.en: Isamu Noguchi (1904–1988) was a Japanese-American sculptor who treated light as another material to shape. In 1951 he visited Gifu, a town known for its paper lanterns, and began the AKARI series: washi paper over bamboo ribbing, named with the Japanese word for light, brightness and lightness. More than seventy years on, each shade is still made by hand by Ozeki & Co. in Gifu, stretched over wooden forms Noguchi designed.
body.zh: 野口勇（Isamu Noguchi，1904–1988）是日裔美籍雕塑家，把「光」當成可以塑造的材料。1951 年他到訪以紙燈籠聞名的岐阜，開始創作 AKARI 系列：以和紙貼在竹骨上，取名自日文「明かり」，意思是光、明亮，也有輕盈之意。七十多年後的今天，每一盞仍由岐阜的尾関（Ozeki）工房，在野口勇設計的木模上人手製作。

body.en: Anna Dawson is a RISD-trained designer and California surfer. Heller spotted her Swell prototype at WantedDesign during NYCxDesign in 2022, and a year later launched it at ICFF, in collaboration with MoMA. Its wave-shaped curves have since picked up a Domino decor award (2023) and an Apartment Therapy Small/Cool award (2024). Swell Mini followed in 2025.
body.zh: Anna Dawson 畢業於 RISD（羅德島設計學院），也是一位加州滑浪愛好者。2022 年 NYCxDesign 期間，Heller 在 WantedDesign 展覽看中她的 Swell 原型，翌年在 ICFF 正式推出，並與 MoMA 合作發佈。這個波浪造型其後獲得 Domino 2023 家居擺設獎及 Apartment Therapy 2024 Small/Cool 獎；2025 年再推出 Swell Mini。

body.en: DULTON is a Japanese homeware brand known for taking everyday, utilitarian objects and making them more fun to live with. The Double Face Clock borrows from the two-sided clocks hung in train stations and public buildings, redrawn as a low rectangle for homes with lower ceilings.
body.zh: DULTON 是日本家品品牌，擅長把日常實用的工具變得更有趣、更好用。雙面掛鐘參考了火車站及公共建築常見的雙面鐘，改成矮身長方形，樓底較矮的家居都啱用。

name.zh: 雙面掛鐘（長方形）· 灰色

material.en: ABS resin body and frame, glass cover
material.zh: ABS 樹脂機身及外框、玻璃面

description.en: The kind of two-sided clock you'd check on a station platform, reworked for home. DULTON drew it as a long, low rectangle so it sits comfortably under HK ceiling heights, with embossed resin details and a glass cover. In grey it leans industrial, closest to the station clocks it borrows from, and suits concrete, steel or black-and-white rooms.
description.zh: 靈感來自火車站月台那種雙面鐘，DULTON 把它改成適合家居的長方形，矮身設計，香港樓底都掛得落。樹脂機身帶浮雕細節，配玻璃面。灰色偏向工業風，最接近它參考的車站鐘，配水泥、金屬或黑白灰色調的空間都好夾。

en: Two dials, readable from both sides
Sweep movement, so no ticking
Dial held by magnets for easy time-setting and battery changes
Runs on 2 × AA batteries
zh: 雙面鐘面，兩邊都睇到時間
掃秒機芯，冇滴答聲
鐘面以磁石固定，調時間及換電池都方便
使用 2 粒 AA 電池

material.en: Washi paper, bamboo ribbing, steel wire

description.en: Noguchi called his AKARI light sculptures rather than lamps, and the 55D shows why. Its bamboo ribbing is set in a loose, organic rhythm under hand-laid washi, so the light comes through soft and a little uneven, like paper held up to the sun. At 55 cm across it's generous enough to anchor a dining table or warm up a bare corner.
description.zh: 野口勇稱 AKARI 為「光的雕塑」，而不只是燈，55D 就是最好的例子。竹骨以隨意、有機的節奏排列，再貼上人手和紙，光線透出來柔和得來帶點層次，好似將紙張舉向太陽。直徑 55 cm，吊喺餐枱上或者放喺空蕩蕩的角落，都即刻令空間暖起來。

name.zh: Swell 波浪掛牆收納 · 白色

year.zh: 2022 年設計，Heller 於 2023 年推出

description.en: Anna Dawson, a California surfer, shaped Swell after the rhythm of ocean waves. The crests catch coats, bags and caps; the troughs cradle keys and sunglasses. It's the entryway fix for a small flat that also happens to look like a sculpture. In white it almost disappears into a pale wall, leaving just the curves and their shadows: the most minimal of the three.
description.zh: 設計師 Anna Dawson 是加州的滑浪愛好者，Swell 的線條就是海浪的起伏。浪尖可以掛外套、袋和帽，浪谷可以放鎖匙和太陽眼鏡。細單位玄關的收納救星，掛上牆又似一件雕塑。白色幾乎融入淺色牆身，只留下波浪的弧線和光影，是三款之中最簡約的。

en: Holds up to 34 kg (75 lb), per Heller
Wall-mounted, with Heller fixings
Apartment Therapy Small/Cool Design Award 2024
zh: 根據 Heller，承重可達 34 kg（75 lb）
掛牆安裝，配 Heller 配件
2024 年 Apartment Therapy Small/Cool 設計獎

name.zh: Swell 波浪掛牆收納 · 藍色

year.zh: 2022 年設計，Heller 於 2023 年推出

description.en: Anna Dawson, a California surfer, shaped Swell after the rhythm of ocean waves. The crests catch coats, bags and caps; the troughs cradle keys and sunglasses. It's the entryway fix for a small flat that also happens to look like a sculpture. Blue is calm and a little beachy, a nod to the ocean that inspired it, and pairs with the blue Swell Mini.
description.zh: 設計師 Anna Dawson 是加州的滑浪愛好者，Swell 的線條就是海浪的起伏。浪尖可以掛外套、袋和帽，浪谷可以放鎖匙和太陽眼鏡。細單位玄關的收納救星，掛上牆又似一件雕塑。藍色清爽帶點海灘感，呼應啟發它的海浪，亦可以配藍色 Swell Mini。
